alt: Dimly lit car repair workshop with a dark-red classic American car under an open hood, an engine hanging from a hoist, red tool chests and stacked tires
author: Martin Vorel
notes: Original search terms returned zero Commons results; found via 'automobile repair shop'. Vintage/classic-car garage aesthetic rather than a modern performance shop — fits a premium mockup but flag if a modern clean-room shop was expected.

alt: Orange Lamborghini Aventador parked nose-forward in a dark luxury garage, with green and yellow Gallardos behind it
author: Ben (Flickr)
notes: Real photograph; setting is a premium showroom-style garage rather than a residential home garage — Commons has essentially no high-res home-garage sports car photos. Well-composed, landscape, hero-suitable.

alt: White Opel Astra hatchback running on a chassis dynamometer in a factory test bay, front wheel blurred in motion with monitors and control panels on the wall
author: Marek Ślusarczyk (Tupungato)
notes: Chose the 004 frame over the near-identical 005 for more natural white balance. Yellow exhaust-extraction hoses cross part of the frame; shot through the test-booth glass at the Opel Gliwice factory.

alt: Cockpit of a blue Triumph Spitfire roadster with a black three-spoke sports steering wheel, wood-veneer dashboard gauges, and tan leather seats in bright daylight
author: Deerpeter
notes: First candidate (Wiesmann GT racing wheel, Dietmar Rabich) was rejected on visual check: shot through acrylic display panels, cluttered composition. This Spitfire cockpit replaced it and passed.

alt: Rear view of a dark Porsche 911 Carrera with glowing red taillights on a rain-soaked city street at dusk, wet pavement reflecting the lights
author: Gabriel Gurrola
notes: Shows glowing taillights (rear view) rather than headlights, but is a strong cinematic night/dusk hero of a performance car; exact 'headlights at night' searches returned no usable >=1600px real photos.

notes: Original literal searches returned zero/irrelevant hits; found via 'cars and coffee' query. Original is 2896px wide, downloaded rendition is 1920x1289.

alt: Black TSCO Racing trophy truck on huge off-road tires kicking up a dust plume across the Nevada desert at the Mint 400, chase helicopter flying low overhead
author: Mobilus In Mobili
notes: Subject is a purpose-built desert race trophy truck (pickup-bodied) rather than a street lifted pickup — the only literal lifted street pickup found (Ford F-250 on winter grass) was far weaker as a hero. License is ShareAlike; downloaded rendition is 1920x1080.
